name: fullstack-agent-cli-install
summary: Install the four-part agent environment using the fullstack-agent GitHub repository installer.
steps: Install Node.js and ensure Claude Code CLI is set up and authenticated.
Clone the installer repository: git clone https://github.com/jaredrhod/fullstack-agent.
Execute the setup command via terminal.
Follow the interactive prompts to install all four subsystems or pick individual components.
Verify configuration files are populated with required API tokens.
jarvis_use: Bootstrap modular AI operator tooling through a single installation command.

name: modular-component-selection-pattern
summary: Selectively decouple the agent's memory, visualizer, voice, and hand subsystems depending on the underlying LLM provider.
steps: Determine target LLM: if using Anthropic Claude SDK, install all four subsystems including backtalk.
If using external LLMs (e.g. OpenAI GPT-4o, Ollama), omit backtalk.
Clone ai-memory-vault for plain-text persistent context.
Clone ai-visualizer for state-reactive audio/HUD display.
Clone barehands for touchless optical gesture control.
Configure each standalone component independently.
jarvis_use: Architect decoupled desktop interfaces that survive switching underlying language models.

name: push-to-talk-voice-input-backtalk
summary: Capture operator speech using a single hotkey press to eliminate background noise triggers and ensure precise turn-taking.
steps: Configure backtalk to bind a dedicated hotkey (e.g. Spacebar hold).
Hold the hotkey down and speak natural language command into microphone.
Observe visualizer transition immediately to LISTENING status with active oscilloscope waveform.
Release hotkey upon finishing speech to trigger end-of-turn detection.
Audio stream is immediately dispatched to STT pipeline without waiting for acoustic silence timeouts.
jarvis_use: Provide reliable, zero-false-positive voice command input during noisy development sessions.

name: hotword-wake-listener
summary: Continuously listen for a local keyword ('Jarvis') to trigger speech recognition hands-free.
steps: Enable continuous audio buffer monitoring in backtalk.
Listen for the specific wake phrase 'JARVIS' via lightweight local detection.
Upon keyword trigger, switch visualizer state to LISTENING and start recording the query.
Process trailing utterance until silence pause is identified.
jarvis_use: Enable hands-free background triggering when away from keyboard or mouse.

name: real-time-audio-oscilloscope-display
summary: Render a real-time oscilloscope waveform responding to mic input volume to visually confirm microphone capture.
steps: Stream audio input buffer to a Web Audio API AnalyserNode.
Extract time-domain data during LISTENING state.
Draw continuous sine wave curve inside central HUD frame on HTML5 canvas.
Adjust amplitude and line glow dynamically according to vocal volume.
jarvis_use: Give immediate visual feedback confirming macOS microphone gain and speech detection.

name: cryptographic-character-scramble-thinking-indicator
summary: Display high-speed randomized alphanumeric character sequences to visually communicate background LLM inference and tool execution.
steps: Detect completion of user utterance and initiate agent inference call.
Switch HUD state to THINKING with green status indicator.
Execute an animation loop cycling random alphanumeric and symbol strings (<WTY39VV6.Z8, *TWNI%9QF>*X, P6F01V6TIZ?E) in fixed-width blocks.
Maintain scramble cycle continuously throughout long-running tool calls (e.g. bash execution, file search).
Terminate scramble upon receiving first text or audio chunk from model response.
jarvis_use: Provide visual proof of ongoing execution during high-latency multi-step reasoning.

name: synchronized-hud-speaking-pulse
summary: Pulse circuit board traces and central branding in sync with synthetic voice output audio.
steps: Receive streaming audio buffer from TTS backend.
Switch HUD state to SPEAKING with active timestamp counter.
Analyze output audio amplitude in real time.
Modulate brightness, glow filters, and pulse frequency of HUD circuit board lines in sync with voice cadence.
Transition to IDLE state once playback buffer finishes.
jarvis_use: Give agent vocal responses physical presence and clear turn-ending cues on desktop.

name: pushback-personality-system-prompt
summary: Configure persona system prompts to actively challenge flawed user assumptions rather than acting as a compliant yes-man.
steps: Embed directive in system prompt explicitly prohibiting unconditional agreement.
Instruct agent to evaluate logical consistency and edge cases of operator proposals.
Instruct agent to verbally object and provide counter-proposals when an idea has architectural flaws.
Adopt a frank, professional, mildly colloquial tone (e.g. British assistant persona) to enhance conversational realism.
jarvis_use: Prevent operator cognitive blind spots during architectural design and coding sessions.

name: claude-code-local-file-mutation
summary: Read, edit, and rewrite local codebase files directly using Claude Code terminal tools.
steps: Grant Claude Code read and write permissions to workspace directory.
Agent inspects existing code files using grep and file-view tools.
Agent drafts proposed modifications or complete file rewrites.
Agent writes changes directly to filesystem and verifies syntax.
Agent reports diffs or actions taken back to user via voice or terminal.
jarvis_use: Perform automated codebase edits and bug fixes directly from voice commands.

name: claude-code-host-shell-execution
summary: Execute genuine terminal commands on host machine to run tests, inspect servers, and manage background jobs.
steps: Issue natural language directive requiring system action.
Agent parses task and formulates bash command string.
Agent executes command directly in host shell via Claude Code tool interface.
Agent captures stdout and stderr to verify command success.
Agent takes corrective action if non-zero exit codes occur.
jarvis_use: Execute build pipelines, restart services, and check system health via voice.

name: web-search-information-verification
summary: Trigger live web searches when local knowledge or memory vault lacks current technical information.
steps: Agent evaluates query against internal weights and memory vault files.
If information is absent, outdated, or requires live verification, agent invokes search tool.
Agent parses search results and extracts authoritative technical facts.
Agent synthesizes findings without hallucinating confidence.
Agent stores new reference links or facts into local memory vault for future reuse.
jarvis_use: Ground operational decisions in live documentation and real-time external data.

name: parallel-subagent-task-branching
summary: Spin up concurrent sub-agent processes to investigate multiple technical avenues in parallel while keeping primary conversation open.
steps: Identify multi-pronged task requiring distinct exploration paths.
Spawn secondary Claude Code sub-agent threads via tool execution.
Assign distinct objective, file targets, and constraints to each sub-process.
Sub-agents execute bash/search operations concurrently in background.
Primary agent maintains conversation with user, aggregating results as sub-agents report back.
jarvis_use: Execute broad codebase audits and multi-file refactoring without locking the primary interactive session.

name: obsidian-vault-persistent-memory-architecture
summary: Store all agent memories as plain-text markdown files inside an Obsidian vault on local disk.
steps: Designate an Obsidian vault directory on local storage for agent memory.
Structure sub-directories by operational category (e.g. Daily Notes, Company A, Company B, Dev, Personal, Resources, Marketing, Jarvis).
Place plain markdown files inside each folder documenting processes, keys, business strategy, and preferences.
Configure Claude Code to mount the vault directory as its working memory root.
Read and update these files across sessions, ensuring zero data loss and human inspectability.
jarvis_use: Build an inspectable, lifelong memory foundation that avoids vector DB lock-in.

name: root-memory-index-bootstrapping
summary: Bootstrap agent context at the start of every session by reading a standardized root index file.
steps: Create a root index markdown file (e.g. Stream Vault/index.md) in the vault root.
Include standardized YAML frontmatter: status: active, project: meta, type: index.
Include explicit instruction: 'Read this file at the start of every conversation to understand who I am, how we work together, and how this vault is organized'.
Detail personal bio, active businesses, system runbooks, and file-tree routing conventions.
Configure agent startup prompt to inspect this file first on every invocation.
jarvis_use: Instantly establish operator identity, active projects, and workspace rules on session start.

name: barehands-touchless-spatial-overlay
summary: Control on-screen windows and assets using standard webcam optical tracking without VR headsets or gloves.
steps: Launch barehands application window overlaying desktop or camera feed.
Initialize webcam stream and pass video frames into optical hand tracking pipeline.
Compute 3D coordinates for palm centroid and finger landmarks.
Anchor circular master HUD element ('J.A.R.V.I.S. ACTIVE') to spatial hand coordinates.
Render virtual interactive floating interface directly on monitor screen.
jarvis_use: Enable gestural screen control and HUD interaction while standing or away from keyboard.

name: two-hand-pinch-zoom-scaling
summary: Scale floating AR windows and models up or down using dual-hand pinch gestures.
steps: Pinch thumb and index finger on left hand over an active spatial window.
Simultaneously pinch thumb and index finger on right hand over the same element.
Calculate Euclidean distance between left and right pinch coordinates.
Moving hands further apart scales window/asset proportionally larger.
Moving hands closer together scales window/asset proportionally smaller.
Release pinch on either hand to lock current scale.
jarvis_use: Dynamically resize research documents and media viewports using natural spatial gestures.

name: closed-fist-3d-perspective-tilt
summary: Rotate and orient 3D objects or floating panes in perspective space by rotating a closed fist.
steps: Move hand cursor over target 3D viewport or document.
Form a closed fist to initiate 3D rotation lock.
Track wrist roll, pitch, and yaw angles relative to webcam plane.
Apply transform matrix to rotate target element in full 3D perspective space.
Open hand to release rotation lock and hold orientation.
jarvis_use: Examine 3D models and tilt reference windows to comfortable viewing angles.

name: radial-satellite-menu-navigation
summary: Navigate directory structures via orbiting circular satellite bubbles expanding from a central hub.
steps: Click or pinch the central J.A.R.V.I.S. circular hub.
Deploy animated satellite bubbles around the hub representing root folders (VAULT, PROPS, WIDGETS).
Hover over a satellite bubble to reveal label and contents summary.
Pinch a satellite bubble to expand its sub-directory tree as a floating translucent list.
Pinch hub again or click outside to collapse satellite bubbles.
jarvis_use: Provide rapid gestural access to file trees without traditional desktop file manager clutter.

name: interactive-3d-glb-ar-rendering
summary: Load and render 3D GLB assets in real-time AR space manipulated via bare-hand gestures.
steps: Navigate to props/holo directory using gestural file tree.
Pinch a .glb asset file (e.g. coin.glb, iron-man-mach-1.glb).
Drag file node into workspace to instantiate a WebGL 3D model viewport.
Render asset with custom lighting and translucent holographic shaders.
Rotate, scale, and inspect the 3D model using pinch and fist rotation gestures.
jarvis_use: Preview and manipulate 3D models and CAD assets touchlessly on screen.

name: flick-gesture-window-dismissal
summary: Dismiss or close floating AR windows and 3D objects with a rapid hand flicking motion.
steps: Grab an active floating element using pinch gesture.
Accelerate hand rapidly toward screen edge or away from center.
Release pinch while hand velocity exceeds threshold.
System detects flick vector and triggers dismissal animation with swoosh sound effect.
Object is unloaded from DOM / WebGL scene.
jarvis_use: Quickly clear unwanted floating overlays from the visual workspace.

name: voice-to-spatial-media-projection
summary: Retrieve specific visual files using natural language voice commands and project them onto floating spatial display panes.
steps: Issue voice command specifying desired media: 'Hey Jarvis, can you show them a picture of [Item]'.
Agent resolves request to matching image file path on local filesystem.
Agent sends an IPC command containing file path to barehands UI renderer.
Barehands instantiates floating translucent frame displaying retrieved photograph.
Operator immediately manipulates image size and placement using pinch gestures.
jarvis_use: Instantly pull reference images and schematics onto screen by voice during work.

name: remote-claw-raycast-targeting
summary: Target distant floating UI elements by forming a claw hand shape and pull them forward by making a fist.
steps: Extend hand toward webcam with fingers curled into an open claw shape.
Barehands casts a selection ray from hand center toward on-screen elements.
Targeted element begins vibrating/jittering to confirm acquisition.
Close fingers into a tight fist to lock selection.
Pull fist toward body or across screen to drag target element.
Open hand to release and drop element in place.
jarvis_use: Select and retrieve floating windows across large multi-monitor displays without moving closer.

name: in-situ-markdown-reading-in-ar
summary: Open and read persistent memory vault markdown documents directly inside floating glassmorphic AR panes.
steps: Open VAULT satellite menu in barehands.
Navigate file list to target markdown file (e.g. 01 - Daily Notes, Stream Vault).
Pinch file name to open a semi-transparent text rendering pane.
Render markdown headers, frontmatter metadata, and text paragraphs formatted for legibility.
Use two-hand pinch to expand text pane for reading.
Tap top border bar to close document when finished.
jarvis_use: Inspect and verify agent memory notes and runbooks without leaving current visual workspace.

name: top-bar-tap-window-close
summary: Close any active floating spatial window by tapping its top header boundary.
steps: Position hand index finger over top boundary bar of floating window.
Perform forward tapping gesture towards camera plane.
Hit-test confirms intersection with window close trigger.
Window triggers closing animation and is destroyed from scene graph.
jarvis_use: Provide an intuitive, fast touch target to dismiss floating windows without tiny close buttons.
